solutionSql:
SELECT customer_id, id
FROM (
  SELECT customer_id, id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY booked_at DESC, id DESC) AS rn
  FROM shipments
) latest
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY customer_id;
notes: Six customers have shipments. Customers 1 and 2 return shipments 1 and 2 because the seed gives those two the latest booked_at values. A DISTINCT ON formulation agrees.
